# AnyX

> AnyX is a universal payment adapter for the x402 protocol. It lets any token
> holder — ETH, USDT, WBTC, cbBTC, SOL, BTC via Lightning, or any ERC-20 — pay
> x402-gated APIs without manually acquiring USDC. AnyX handles the swap, the
> EIP-3009 authorization and the settlement. API providers receive standard
> USDC on Base via x402, unchanged.

NOTE: The hostnames below are placeholders. This project is pre-launch and no
public endpoint is deployed yet. Run it yourself with `./scripts/setup.sh` and
use `http://localhost:3000`.

## What AnyX does

- Intercepts the 402 challenge and reads the required USDC amount and recipient
- Quotes the payer's token against USDC via 1inch and 0x in parallel, taking the better route
- Applies a transparent spread (0.05%-0.50% depending on the pair)
- Executes the swap, reverting if the output would fall short of the required amount
- Signs EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on the payer's behalf
- Submits to an x402 facilitator, with automatic failover to a second one
- Returns the API response together with an itemized payment receipt

## What AnyX does not do

- Change the x402 protocol, or require anything of the API provider
- Custody funds, beyond the seconds between a Lightning settlement and the USDC authorization
- Accept fiat
- Allow a partial payment. A swap that comes up short reverts.

## API base URL

http://localhost:3000  (self-hosted; no public deployment yet)

## Authentication

Optional API key in the `X-API-Key` header.
Free tier: 100 requests/minute. Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute.

## Core endpoints

### Get a quote — always call this before paying

POST /v1/quote

```json
{
  "endpointUrl": "https://api.example.com/data",
  "inputToken": "ETH",
  "inputChainId": 8453
}
```

Returns `{ quoteId, inputToken, inputAmount, usdcRequired, fee, expiresAt, route }`.
Quotes are valid for 30 seconds, bound to DEX quote freshness.

### Pay

POST /v1/pay

```json
{
  "quoteId": "uuid-from-the-quote",
  "walletAddress": "0x..."
}
```

Returns `{ receiptId, txHash, apiResponse, status }`.

### Retrieve a receipt

GET /v1/receipt/{receiptId}

Returns the itemized breakdown: input token and amount, USD equivalent, the USDC
sent to the provider, the AnyX fee, actual slippage, transaction hash, block
number, and the facilitator used.

### List supported tokens

GET /v1/tokens

Returns every supported input token with its address, chain and current USD price.

### Lightning invoice

POST /v1/lightning/invoice

```json
{ "endpointUrl": "https://api.example.com/data" }
```

Returns a BOLT-11 invoice, the amount in satoshis, the USDC equivalent and an
expiry. Not yet implemented; it is Phase 4.

### Health

GET /health

Returns status plus which capabilities are degraded and why. Useful for
determining what a given deployment can actually do.

## SDK

```bash
npm install @anyx/sdk
```

```ts
import { UPA } from '@anyx/sdk';

const upa = new UPA({ preferredToken: 'ETH', preferredChainId: 8453, wallet });

// A drop-in for fetch. A 402 is handled internally.
const res = await upa.fetch('https://api.example.com/data');
const data = await res.json();
```

Methods: `fetch(url, init?)`, `quote(url)`, `pay(url, quoteId?)`,
`getReceipt(id)`, `getSupportedTokens()`.
Events: `payment`, `swap`, `error`.

## Supported tokens

Base (chain 8453): ETH, WETH, USDC, USDT, cbBTC, and any ERC-20 routable by 0x
Ethereum (chain 1): ETH, WETH, USDT, WBTC
Solana (chain 101): SOL, USDC, SPL tokens — via Jupiter and Circle CCTP
Bitcoin: BTC over Lightning — Phase 4

## Fees

A swap spread, applied on top of the required amount rather than taken out of
it, so the provider always receives exactly what it asked for:

    inputAmount = requiredUSDC / (1 - feeBps / 10000)

| Pair | Spread |
| --- | --- |
| USDT to USDC | 0.05% |
| ETH to USDC | 0.20% |
| BTC to USDC | 0.50% |
| Cross-chain | 0.30% |

No flat fee on the free tier.

## Errors

All errors return `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {} } }`.

Codes: QUOTE_NOT_FOUND, QUOTE_EXPIRED, SWAP_FAILED, SETTLEMENT_FAILED,
INVALID_INPUT, RATE_LIMITED, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.

## Guidance for AI agents

- Call `/v1/quote` before `/v1/pay` and check the fee against your budget.
- A quote expires in 30 seconds. Do not cache one across turns.
- `upa.fetch()` is the simplest integration: it behaves like `fetch` and handles
  a 402 without you writing any payment logic.
- Payments are irreversible. Treat `maxFeePercent` in the SDK config as a real
  guardrail rather than a formality.
- A `SWAP_FAILED` usually means slippage moved beyond tolerance. Re-quote rather
  than retrying the same quote.
